_comment: A1409: browser 3D asset builders. These pages live in workshops/ (URLs stay /workshops/<id>.html) but are catalogued as Tools, not workshops. generate-content-data.js excludes these ids from workshops.json and appends them to tools.json so they appear in the Toolbox 3D Builders group.

builders.title: Rocket Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D rocket: nosecone, body, boosters, fins and engine bells, then launch it.

builders.title: Robot Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D robot: head, body, arms, legs, weapons and more, then power it up.

builders.title: Castle Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D medieval castle: walls, towers, gates, keeps, moats and banners.

builders.title: Space Station Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D space station: modules, solar panels, docking ports and antennas.

builders.title: Fairy Tale Cottage
builders.desc: Design a 3D fairy tale cottage: roof, windows, doors, garden and towers.

builders.title: Pirate Ship Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D pirate ship: choose the hull, sails and cannons, then sail it.

builders.title: Steampunk Airship
builders.desc: Design a steampunk airship: balloon, hull, propellers and fins, then fly it.

builders.title: Race Car Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D race car: body, engine, wheels, aero parts and livery, then race it.

builders.title: Submarine Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D submarine: hull, conning tower, propeller, fins and sonar, then dive.

builders.title: Pirate Cannon Builder
builders.desc: Build and fire a pirate cannon game: set the ship, cannon power and targets, then play.

builders.title: Phone Stand Builder
builders.desc: Design a 3D printable phone stand: style, size, angle and grip, then export an STL to print.
